subject: SERVERZ underground data centre, Zim Urban (Zim Center) complex, Kfar Saba KS/50 employment zone, Israel
source_service: Israel Planning Administration Xplan ArcGIS REST MapServer (PlanningPublic/Xplan): layer 4 land-use plots and layer 1 plan boundaries (blue lines), queried by pl_number 405-0657783

plan.pl_name: כס/50/1/ד - צים סנטר - מרכז מסחר תעסוקה ולוגיסטיקה
plan.pl_name_translation: KS/50/1/D - Zim Center - commerce, employment and logistics centre
plan.objectives_summary: Establish a commerce, logistics and employment centre; merge plots 60-62, 71 and 72 of plan KS/1/50/A into a new unified plot 200 split into two cells; add building rights and instructions in cell 200A; add employment and further uses (text truncated in the service attribute).

other_plot.note: Private open space cell of the same plan; not selected because the plan assigns the buildable commerce and employment rights to cell 200A.

method: Planar area centroid of the native plot 200A ring computed with shapely 2.1.1 in EPSG:2039, transformed once to WGS 84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1) and rounded to 7 decimals; no vertex dropped, reordered or snapped.

transformation.source_crs: EPSG:2039 Israel 1993 / Israeli TM Grid, as declared by the response spatialReference (wkid and latestWkid 2039)
transformation.operation: Inverse of Israeli TM + Israel 1993 to WGS 84 (2) + axis order change (2D); first operation of pyproj TransformerGroup(2039, 4326, always_xy=True, allow_ballpark=False), identical to the default Transformer result
transformation.accuracy_caveat: The 0.5 m figure is the datum-transformation accuracy, not the positional accuracy of the planning plot.

checks.label: Qualitative imagery check (Esri World Imagery tile z17/53147/78261, captured 7 November 2026; nothing copied)
checks.result: The plot 200A ring spans pixel x 144.9-307.3 and y 47.3-267.6 of the tile and the centroid falls at pixel [234.4, 161.4], on a single very large flat-roofed building with extensive rooftop plant and solar arrays that fills the eastern part of the tile, beside a roundabout; imagery date and accuracy unknown.

neighbourhood_plan_screen: An Xplan layer 1 envelope query of about 600 by 600 m around the plot (EPSG:2039 195480-196080, 676660-677260) returns 22 plans; 405-0657783 is the only site-specific commercial, employment or logistics plan; the others are city-wide or regional outline, conservation, roof, pool, basement and building-renewal plans, national transport, electrification, metro and sewage plans, the Kfar Saba East bus-terminal plan and the eastern-cemetery regularisation plan. A Kfar Saba plan-list query returns 146 plans, and 405-0657783 is the only one whose name contains Zim (צים).
plot_semantics: A land-use designation cell of an approved statutory plan, not a registered cadastral parcel, building footprint or the underground data-hall outline. The data centre is reported as underground (in the basement) of the complex on this plot; its exact extent beneath the plot is not published.
